_comment: 2.566.0: + group moss (Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image - the bf16 and int8 text encoder sizes are approximate; the download uses Hugging Face's own). 2.555.0: + group inpaint (the Krita AI plugin's fill models, its presets/models.json). 2.331.0: every model file bitGen Studio's shipped workflows and features load, with its Hugging Face source. dest: comfy/<folder> = ComfyUI's models/<folder>; app/<folder> = the app's own folder; hf-cache = a snapshot into the Hugging Face cache (read on first use). as = the name the workflows ask for when the repo names it differently. size = bytes (the wizard replaces it with the live size). The wizard asks each repo LIVE whether it is gated - no token = only the open ones. The workflows' own file names were checked against the shipped comfy_workflows (scripts/test-setup.js keeps them in step). 2.332.0 adds the image editor's edit engines (Kontext + FLUX Fill inpaint share clip_l / t5xxl_fp16 / ae; Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 int8 + its Lightning LoRA), the files ComfyUI's own templates link. 2.402.0 adds LTX 2.3 (group video_ltx23: the fp8 checkpoints, distilled LoRA, Gemma 3 encoder, x2 upscaler, fal's 3DREAL IC-LoRAs - 3DREAL sizes approximate, the wizard reads them live). 2.338.0 adds LTX 2.5 (group video_ltx; not recommended by default - big, and Lightricks' repo is gated). 2.337.0 adds Qwen Image 2.1 (the scene cards' ✎ First frame). 2.334.0 adds akatz-ai's H3 Character Swap LoRA (the swap stacks it on its LoRA loader when ComfyUI has it). Checked against the repos' file trees, September 2026. 2.502.0 adds FLUX 3 Image Klein (black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy, gated; its VAE is FLUX.2's flux2-vae). 2.516.0 adds Krea 2 (Comfy-Org/Krea-2: Turbo + Raw fp8 scaled, the Qwen3-VL 4B fp8 encoder; vantagewithai's Turbo / Raw GGUF Q5_K_M; the VAE is the Qwen-Image VAE already listed). 2.517.0 adds Anima (circlestone-labs/Anima: Aesthetic v1.1 + Base v1.0, the Qwen3 0.6B encoder; the Qwen-Image VAE already listed).

Images - MOSS-Image (the MOSS-Image styles; Settings ▸ Add-ons ▸ MOSS-Image picks what to download)

Selection fill - the Krita AI way (Generate / Remove in a selection with SDXL, Pony, Illustrious, SD 1.5, FLUX.1)
3D models - a picture -> a 3D model (✨ Build a scene with AI, 🧊 on a picture): Hunyuan3D 2.1 = the shape, TRELLIS.2 = shape + texture
